debug.description: Persist request/response bodies to the session.

base_url.description: Override for proxies / OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Setting it narrows the default api to chat_completions.

api.description: Which OpenAI API to speak. Default responses, because from GPT-5.4 onward Chat Completions refuses tool calling with any reasoning_effort other than none and Nexus puts tools on every turn; narrowed to chat_completions when base_url or an Azure auth mode is set. Both surfaces are implemented end to end. Changed in v0.29.0: a plain api.openai.com deployment that names no api: used to speak chat_completions.

mode.description: Whether reasoning controls go on the wire. effort -> send reasoning_effort; off -> send no reasoning configuration at all.

effort.description: Reasoning depth. Unset under mode: effort sends no reasoning_effort, so the model's own default applies.

summary.description: Reasoning-summary verbosity. Rides the reasoning object on api: responses; dropped with one Init warning on api: chat_completions, which has no summary field. Also gates thinking.step emission.

enabled.description: Deprecated alias for mode: true -> effort, false -> off. Ignored when mode is set.

budget_tokens.description: Deprecated and ignored: OpenAI has no reasoning token budget. Use effort.

vision.description: Allow image parts onto the wire. false drops them from every request on both API surfaces and skips uploading them.

default_image_detail.description: Image fidelity requested for every image part.

pricing.description: Per-model pricing overrides; keys are model IDs.
